name: Isekai Heat Massage ~Ken to Mahou no Sekai o H na Shiatsu Skill de Musou Seiatsu!!~
original_name: 異世界Hィートマッサージ ～剣と魔法の世界をHな指圧スキルで無双制圧!!～
source:
Anma Yubio is a 25 years-old massage therapist working at a high-class salon. 

He is a nice young man who finds pleasure in healing people from their tiredness. But one day, he died in an unfortunate accident. However, the goddess took pity on him and reincarnated him in a world of swords and magic.

And with the cheat massage ability given to him by the goddess which can makes a demon queen and a knight in this fantasy world go crazy;

A new H adventure is about to begin!!

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=1497332]Melonbooks[/url]]
translation:
安马指男，25岁，是一名在高级美容院工作的按摩师。

他是个善良的青年，以缓解人们的疲劳为乐。然而某天，他不幸死于一场意外。女神怜悯他的遭遇，便让他转生到了剑与魔法的世界。

凭借女神赐予的超规格按摩能力，连这个奇幻世界的女魔王与女骑士，都将被他按得欲仙欲死。

一场全新的情色冒险，即将开始！

[编译自[url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=1497332]Melonbooks[/url]]
